kinds.d: Bowl that holds shisha on a hookah, the phunnel included.
Cap set on a hookah bowl between charcoal and tobacco that holds the coal in place of foil and controls the heat.

x.d: Original HMD from Kaloud: base plate holding the charcoal, ventilated wall and rotating lids; Kaloud's patent was filed in 2012.

kinds.d: Charcoal made to heat shisha on a hookah.
Tongs for handling hookah charcoal, with windcovers shielding coals from wind and electric coal burners to light them.
Flexible hose, with its mouthpiece handle, that carries smoke from a hookah to the smoker.
Small disposable or reusable tip fitted over a hookah hose mouthpiece for hygiene.
Small chamber fitted between hookah stem and hose that traps syrup and liquid.
Wearing parts replaced on a hookah: grommets, diffusers, downstems and base gaskets.

brands.d: Maker of the Lotus heat management device, holder of the 2012 patent filed by Reza Bavar.

notes: Provost HMD, CocoNara and CocoUrth charcoal not on a retrieved page; omitted. Samsaris bowls kept as old models (no retrieved page). Tongs/windcover merged with electric burner as a type; diffuser and grommet merged into one spare-parts kind.
